name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: Side navigation drawer that springs in over a fading scrim — or, with variant="push", shrinks the screen into a rounded 0.92 card and slides it aside like modern mail apps. Swipe in from the edge, drag closed from anywhere on the panel with velocity and rubber-banding, and build the panel from DrawerProfile (soft initials avatar, presence, account switcher), DrawerItems with a spring-in accent-tinted active pill and popping count badges, divided section headings and a DrawerFooter meter. Flat theme colours, hairline edges and soft shadows; haptics throughout.
summary: A side drawer that follows your finger, or pushes the screen aside as a card.
behavior: Swipe in from the screen edge to open and drag the panel or scrim to close. Release velocity decides where it settles, and it rubber-bands past fully open.
The panel springs in over a fading scrim; variant 'push' shrinks the screen into a rounded card and slides it aside. Active items spring in an accent pill and badges pop.
Opening and closing use a short timing instead of a spring, the push variant no longer scales the screen, and item and badge pops are skipped.
A light impact when the drawer opens and a selection tick when a DrawerItem is pressed.
The open panel is marked modal and hides itself when closed. DrawerItems are menu items with selected and disabled states, and the badge is read with the label.
Escape closes it on web; Android back closes it when it is rendered inline.
props: Panel content (usually DrawerItems); scrolls between header and footer.
Pinned above / below the content (DrawerProfile, DrawerHeader, DrawerFooter…).
The screen the drawer belongs to. Enables edge swipe and push; without children the drawer opens in a Modal.
Called on drags, scrim tap, Android back and Escape.
Panel width in points or percent of the container (max 360).
Slide over a dimmed screen, or shrink the screen to a rounded 0.92 card and slide it aside (inline only).
Swipe in from the edge to open (needs children). Taps in the edge zone still reach the screen.
Close on scrim tap and drag.
Overlay variant: scale the screen behind to 0.96 with rounded corners while open (inline).
Light impact on open; DrawerItems tick on press.
